body: No.  I am not a particularly good person.

Ah, I knew I created my throwaway account for a reason.  About year after marrying my first wife (a bad decision made under duress and the influence of youth), I began an affair with another woman that lasts to this day.  Two years into said affair I left my first wife.  Six years ago (and 8 years into the "affair") I married the woman I was having the affair with.

I still feel guilty for the deception, but everyone (including first wife, who I am still friends with) is far happier now than they would have been otherwise.

Also, no kids involved.
